about: DC360's changes to the Scratch editor (scratchfoundation/scratch-editor, GNU AGPL v3, built nightly as a release by github.com/wbuk/scratch-dc360), re-applied to every new version. Each change must match or the new version is not prepared. Most of DC360's changes are in dc360/dc360-scratch.js and dc360-scratch.css, which work through Scratch's own engine and match its menus by their shape, so Scratch's code hardly changes. Scratch's library pictures and sounds come from DC360's own copy (wbuk/scratch-assets), which the updater tops up from assets.txt before a new version can be switched on.

changes.label: DC360 files (Save to DC360, My Work, Current file, Help menu, no uploads, nothing from outside websites), loaded before Scratch starts
Costumes, backdrops and sounds come from DC360's own copy of the Scratch library (wbuk/scratch-assets), never from scratch.mit.edu; projects are never loaded from scratch.mit.edu
The library's pictures (the Choose a Sprite / Costume / Backdrop / Sound boxes) come from DC360's own copy too
Extensions that need an outside website or a device (Face Sensing, Text to Speech, Translate, micro:bit, Force and Acceleration, LEGO EV3, BOOST, WeDo) are hidden from Add an Extension
No outside websites: the Text to Speech and Translate services (scratch.mit.edu) are never called
No outside websites: the tutorial videos (fast.wistia.com) are never loaded
No outside websites: the Face Sensing models (tfhub.dev, cdn.jsdelivr.net) are never loaded
The teacher's player: library files from DC360's own copy
The teacher's player: library pictures from DC360's own copy
The teacher's player: no outside websites (services, videos, models)
